items.name: Rice, white, raw (uncooked)
items.notes: Milled raw rice before cooking. 1 cup raw makes about 3 cups cooked.

items.name: Basmati rice, cooked
items.notes: Plain cooked basmati, no added fat.

items.name: Parboiled rice, cooked
items.notes: Cooked from parboiled (sela, usna) rice.

items.name: Gobindobhog rice, cooked
items.notes: Short-grain aromatic Bengali rice, plain cooked.

items.name: Kalijira rice, cooked
items.notes: Tiny aromatic Bengali rice, plain cooked.

items.name: Red rice (matta), cooked
items.notes: Unpolished red parboiled rice, plain cooked.

items.name: Puffed rice (muri / murmura), plain
items.notes: Plain puffed rice. Very light: a big bowl weighs little.

items.name: Flattened rice, raw (chira / poha)
items.notes: Dry flattened rice. Cooked poha is a separate entry.

items.name: Jeera rice, home style
items.notes: Rice with cumin tempering in a little ghee or oil.

items.name: Ghee rice (ghee bhat), home style
items.notes: Plain rice finished with about 1 tsp ghee per serving.

items.name: Lemon rice, home style
items.notes: Rice tempered with mustard, curry leaves, peanuts and lemon.

items.name: Tamarind rice (pulihora), home style
items.notes: South Indian tamarind rice with peanuts and sesame oil.

items.name: Curd rice, home style
items.notes: Cooked rice mashed with curd and a light tempering.

items.name: Vegetable pulao, home style
items.notes: Rice cooked with mixed vegetables, whole spices and a little oil or ghee.

items.name: Dal khichdi (moong), home style
items.notes: Soft rice and yellow moong dal with a little ghee. Thinner than restaurant khichdi.

items.name: Idli / dosa batter, fermented
items.notes: Ground rice and urad dal batter before cooking.

items.name: Uttapam, onion (home)
items.notes: Thick fermented rice-lentil pancake with onion, cooked with a little oil.

items.name: Oats, rolled, raw
items.notes: Plain rolled oats, no flavouring.

items.name: Oats porridge, cooked with water
items.notes: No milk, no sugar. About 40 g dry oats makes one bowl.

items.name: Oats porridge, cooked with milk
items.notes: Cooked with whole milk, no sugar.

items.name: Dalia (broken wheat), cooked plain
items.notes: Boiled in water or lightly spiced, no added fat.

items.name: Upma (rava), home style
items.notes: Semolina cooked with onion, mustard seeds and a little oil.

items.name: Vermicelli (semiya / seviyan), raw
items.notes: Dry roasted wheat vermicelli.

items.name: Sabudana (sago pearls), dry
items.notes: Dry pearls. They swell a lot when soaked.

items.name: Sabudana khichdi, home style
items.notes: Soaked sago with potato, peanuts and ghee or oil; a fasting dish.

items.name: Samvat rice (barnyard millet), cooked
items.notes: Cooked fasting-day millet rice.

items.name: Ragi mudde (finger millet ball)
items.notes: Steamed ragi flour ball, eaten with sambar or curry.

items.name: Buckwheat flour (kuttu atta)
items.notes: Fasting-day flour for puri and pakora.

items.name: Cornflakes, plain
items.notes: Typical plain cornflakes. Check the pack label for your brand.

items.name: Muesli, fruit and nut (packaged)
items.notes: Brand values vary a lot. Check the pack label.

items.name: Pasta, boiled plain
items.notes: No sauce or oil.

items.name: Instant noodles, masala (dry)
items.notes: Dry block with tastemaker. Brands differ; check the label.

items.name: Sattu (roasted gram flour)
items.notes: Roasted Bengal gram flour used for drinks and stuffing.

items.name: Roti with ghee, home style
items.notes: Whole wheat roti with about 1 tsp ghee smeared on top.

items.name: Multigrain roti, home style
items.notes: Atta with besan, ragi, jowar or soya blends; varies by mix.

items.name: Tandoori roti
items.notes: Whole wheat roti baked in a tandoor; size and fat vary.

items.name: Naan, plain
items.notes: Refined flour leavened bread. Butter naan has more fat.

items.name: Kulcha, plain
items.notes: Plain refined flour kulcha without stuffing.

items.name: Rumali roti
items.notes: Very thin refined flour roti.

items.name: Aloo paratha, home style
items.notes: Whole wheat paratha stuffed with spiced potato, cooked with a little oil.

items.name: Methi paratha, home style
items.notes: Whole wheat paratha with fenugreek leaves.

items.name: Lachha paratha, layered
items.notes: Layered paratha with ghee or oil between layers.

items.name: Puri, whole wheat, fried
items.notes: Deep fried; oil absorbed varies.

items.name: Missi roti
items.notes: Atta and besan roti, spiced.

items.name: Bread, brown / whole wheat
items.notes: Typical packaged brown bread; check the pack.

items.name: Bread toast with butter
items.notes: White bread toasted with about 1 tsp butter per slice.

items.name: Rusk (tea rusk)
items.notes: Dry baked bread slice eaten with tea.

items.name: Toor dal (arhar), dry
items.notes: Dry split pigeon peas.

items.name: Moong dal (yellow, split), dry
items.notes: Dry skinned and split green gram.

items.name: Soya chunks, dry
items.notes: Dry textured soy protein.

items.name: Soya chunks, boiled
items.notes: About 3 times heavier than dry chunks.

items.name: Tofu, firm
items.notes: Plain firm tofu. Brands vary.

items.name: Rajma, boiled plain
items.notes: Boiled without masala.

items.name: Chickpeas, boiled plain
items.notes: Boiled with salt only.

items.name: Moong sprouts, raw
items.notes: Home-sprouted whole moong. Thin bean-sprout types are lower.

items.name: Chana dal, home style
items.notes: Thicker than moong or masoor dal. Bengali cholar dal with coconut is a separate entry.

items.name: Dal makhani, home style
items.notes: Made with less butter and cream than restaurant versions.

items.name: Lauki dal (bottle gourd dal), home style
Sambar, home style
items.notes: Thin tiffin sambar with vegetables and toor dal.

items.name: Rasam, home style
items.notes: Thin tamarind and tomato broth with tempering.

items.name: Baked beans, canned
items.notes: Brand values vary; check the can.

items.name: Egg, whole, raw
items.notes: Edible portion without shell. Medium hen egg is about 50 g.

items.name: Egg, fried (sunny side up)
items.notes: Fried in about 1 tsp oil.

items.name: Scrambled eggs, with butter
items.notes: Two eggs with about 1 tsp butter and a splash of milk.

items.name: Egg bhurji, home style
items.notes: Eggs scrambled with onion, tomato, chilli and oil.

items.name: Omelette, masala (2 eggs)
items.notes: Two eggs with onion, chilli and coriander in about 1 tsp oil.

items.name: Omelette, cheese (2 eggs)
items.notes: Two eggs with a slice of processed cheese.

items.name: Omelette, egg white (3 whites)
items.notes: Three egg whites with about 1 tsp oil.

items.name: Duck egg, boiled
items.notes: Larger and richer than a hen egg.

items.name: Kulthi dal (horse gram dal), home style
Kala masoor dal (brown lentil), home style
Gujarati dal (sweet and sour), home style
items.notes: Thin toor dal with jaggery, kokum or lemon and peanuts.

items.name: Akki roti (rice flour roti)
items.notes: Rice flour flatbread, cooked on a tawa with a little oil.

items.name: Appam (rice hopper), plain
items.notes: Fermented rice and coconut pancake.

items.name: Pesarattu (moong dosa), home style
items.notes: Whole green moong batter dosa.
